name: @kiwa-test/fresh
description: Deno Fresh Islands + Route Handler + Head normalization test adapter for kiwa — invoke Fresh Handler / defineRoute without a Deno runtime, capture partial-hydration Island mounts, and merge Head fragments (meta / title / link) for assertion-based testing (part of the kiwa test framework family)

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
scripts.test:cov: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --coverage --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/route.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/islands.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/head.js' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/tests/**' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/src/index.js'
